title: Load a design image
responsibility: Reads a design image for the shown project and commit and provides a temporary browser URL that the caller can release.

inputs.name: imageUrl.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace supplying the image reader, current snapshot commit and optional project identity. No read is started if the reader connection or commit is absent.

inputs.name: imageUrl.request
inputs.description: The entity identity, design version and SHA-256 image identifier to send to the image reader, or null to request no image. This helper passes those identifiers through without validating them itself.

inputs.name: imageUrl.apply
inputs.description: Receives empty URL and error strings immediately. On success it receives a temporary URL with an empty error; on a failed read it receives an empty URL and the failure converted to text. Returned bytes are presented as a PNG image.

outputs.name: imageUrl
outputs.description: A cleanup function that suppresses later results and releases the temporary URL if one was created. Call it when the view is removed or its project, commit or image changes; it does not cancel the underlying read.
